import sys, unittest
from unittest.mock import patch
import catan_training_experiment as experiment
import test_rollout_snapshot
original_transform = experiment.transform
def unsafe_transform(source, mode, updates):
    transformed = original_transform(source, mode, updates)
    if mode == "batch":
        anchor = "snapshot_obs, snapshot_masks = obs.copy(), masks.copy()"
        assert transformed.count(anchor) == 1
        transformed = transformed.replace(anchor, "snapshot_obs, snapshot_masks = obs, masks")
    return transformed
print("EXPECTED NEGATIVE CONTROL: in-memory no-copy mutant; no helper/source file edited.", flush=True)
suite = unittest.TestSuite(test_rollout_snapshot.RolloutSnapshotTests(name) for name in (
    "test_pending_snapshots_survive_source_overwrite_and_next_update",
    "test_pending_crosses_updates_with_exact_repeated_seat_gae_order",
))
with patch.object(experiment, "transform", side_effect=unsafe_transform):
    result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
raise SystemExit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() else 1)
